description: Build a Nielsen ten-heuristics review worksheet for a screen or flow. Give text (the copy of the flow), html or a url. Returns, for each heuristic, keyword and markup signals found or missing, review prompts, and blanks for findings and 0 to 4 severity. The signals point at where to look; a human evaluation is still required.

html.description: Page HTML, if you have it instead of a URL

task.description: The task the reviewer is evaluating, e.g. 'change a billing address'

url.description: Public page to read instead of pasted text

name: heuristic_worksheet
title: Heuristic review
